name: Train a model from a DataFrame
desc: Fit → inspect → score → evaluate → save an ML model in the VM, end-to-end with train_model

name: Join DataFrames with SQL (query_df)
desc: Combine frames you've already loaded with in-process DuckDB SQL — joins, group-bys, windows — no re-query, no pandas merge chains

name: Train on SageMaker (managed compute)
desc: Submit a non-blocking managed training job from a DataFrame, poll it, load the model, then score — scale out when training needs a bigger machine or GPU

name: Train on SageMaker from S3 (big data, VM-free)
desc: UNLOAD a huge Athena result to S3, train sm_train straight off the S3 pointer, then load + score — for data too big to pull into the VM

name: Deploy a real-time endpoint (SageMaker)
desc: Stand up a serverless endpoint, invoke it live, then clean up — with the instance + stop/start variant

name: Semantic search over a column
desc: Embed a text column once with Titan, then rank rows by meaning for any query

name: RAG: retrieve + cited answer
desc: Ground an LLM answer in a Bedrock Knowledge Base, with sources

name: Classify a text column with an LLM
desc: Label free text into fixed categories with no training data, then quantify it

name: Explore a data source
desc: List every source with list_datasources(), discover tables, inspect a schema, then run your first query
